subject: Post-demo security follow-up & pen test / vuln SLA
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hayes <security@acme-energy.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo security follow-up & pen test / vuln SLA

Tom — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Per our call, I wanted to pull together the immediate next steps on security/compliance so your procurement and infosec teams have a clear MAP. Items below reflect what we discussed (SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, pen testing, and vulnerability handling).

1) SOC 2 status: Redwood is actively in SOC 2 Type II readiness; our current bridge letter and control summary are in the Drive link below. Naomi will share the most recent control-matrix extract for your team to review.

2) GDPR / HIPAA: We discussed data residency and BAA needs. For regulated workloads, Redwood Private (VPC) is the recommended option — we can include a standard BAA clause in the order form.

3) Pen test report & scope: Acme asked for a recent external penetration test report and an agreed-upon cadence going forward. We have a standard pen-test scope and disclosure policy; attached is a draft scope (redwood-pen-test-scope.pdf). Proposed cadence: annual external pen test + quarterly authenticated scans.

4) Vulnerability management SLA: We typically operate with the following target timelines: P0 (critical/remote RCE with exploit) — initial triage within 24 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours; P1 — mitigation plan within 7 days; P2/P3 — standard 30-day cadence. We are open to aligning on SLA for critical systems for enterprise contracts.

5) Vendor security questionnaire: please confirm if you prefer the security questionnaire via SecureDocs (we will send) or a RedCap / Google form. Our standard intake includes evidence attachments for encryption, access controls, and SOC artifacts.

Action items (owners):
- Naomi: share SOC control matrix extract + bridge letter (ETA: EOD Thu)
- Marissa: circulate draft vulnerability policy and recommended SLA (attached vuln-policy-draft.docx)
- Kimberly: coordinate pen-test QSA introduction + sign-off on scope (I will send the MAP spreadsheet)
- Tom / Acme: confirm preferred questionnaire method and primary contact for technical follow-up (DevSecOps).

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-scope.pdf (draft scope), vuln-policy-draft.docx (SLA + triage timelines), MAP-acme-redwood.xlsx (mutual action plan template).

Thanks — want to keep momentum and lock the MAP so procurement can move to PO.

— Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[kimberly_park@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: redwood-pen-test-scope.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Tom Hayes <security@acme-energy.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leila Ahmad <devsecops@greenbank.io>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security follow-up & pen test / vuln SLA

Thanks Kimberly — this is helpful. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: Can you confirm whether Redwood has a completed Type II report or only controls evidence and a Type II in progress? Our procurement needs the exact status to assess timeline.
- Pen test: we need to see the last external pen test report (redacted OK) and the remediation log for high/critical issues from the last 12 months. Can your QSA provide a short summary?
- Vulnerability SLA: Your proposed timelines look reasonable. For critical infra that Acme will host in a VPC, we need a 48-72 hour remediation window; can Redwood commit contractually for dedicated customers?
- Questionnaire: please send the security questionnaire to security@acme-energy.com (we prefer SecureDocs uploads).

Also, who will be our technical contact for scoping (network ranges, auth details, staging environment)? Suggest Leila Ahmad (cc) as our DevSecOps lead.

Tom
Head of Security, Acme Energy
[Attachment: acme-qa-template.xlsx (Microsoft Excel 52 KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo security follow-up & pen test / vuln SLA (scope + Qs)

Looping in our Security Ops and QSA contact to respond to Tom's asks. Proposed internal plan:

- Naomi: please pull latest SOC 2 artifacts — indicate whether we have a Type II report available for disclosure, or only SOC 2 readiness artifacts. If Type II exists, add redacted report and signed letter.
- Marissa: consolidate vuln-policy-draft and add a column with contract language options (commit / best-effort) for P0/P1 SLAs so we can present legal with clear ask.
- I will schedule a 30-minute technical scoping call with Acme + our QSA (prefer Friday morning PST). Rishi to own scheduling + initial QSA intro to Tom.

Notes on disclosure: our standard pen-test disclosure allows sharing of redacted executive summary and remediation summary. Full reports are provided under NDA or via secure portal at the QSA. If Acme requires full reports in contract, we should confirm the level of access and retention.

Action: Naomi/Marissa/Rishi — can you have the draft responses and attachments ready by EOD Thu so Kimberly can send to Acme?

— Rishi
Head of Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: internal-qsa-contact.vcf (text/vcard)]

From: QSA Team <qsa@thirdparty-audit.com>
To: Tom Hayes <security@acme-energy.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leila Ahmad <devsecops@greenbank.io>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security follow-up & pen test / vuln SLA — scheduling & deliverables

Hi all — QSA team here. Thanks for including us. Quick outline of next steps from our side: 

1) We can perform the external penetration test and provide: (a) executive summary for public sharing (redacted), (b) full technical report delivered via secure portal after NDA, (c) a remediation tracking spreadsheet for items classified High/Critical for the past 12 months.

2) Timeline: initial scoping call within 3 business days from accepting the scope; field testing window ~2-3 weeks depending on the environment; final report typically 2-3 weeks after testing completion. We can accelerate timelines for dedicated capacity customers on an approved contract.

3) Disclosure & retention: redacted exec summary is included in standard deliverables; full report requires signed NDA and is stored on our portal for 12 months by default (we can negotiate retention).

4) SLA alignment: we will work with Redwood and Acme to map severity definitions. Our recommended approach: severity-based SLA language in the contract, with Redwood committed to remediation timelines for their managed services and best-effort support for customer-managed components. For Dedicated customers, we can include stricter remediation commitments in the order form.

Next concrete step: please confirm acceptance of the attached pen-test scope and provide preferred windows for scoping call. We will also send the DocuSign scope acceptance link to Kimberly.

Regards,
QSA Team
ThirdParty Audit Services
[Attachment: qsa-pen-scope-terms.pdf (application/pdf)]
